description: The paid plan has no domain or alias limit, 10 destinations for each alias, a 90-day log and send-as to 3,000 recipients a month. It costs 9 USD a month or 79 USD a year. This tool pays nothing: it returns a payment link. Show the link to the person who owns the account; they pay by card on the page of the payment provider. The plan is on about a minute after the payment; get_account shows it. Use it when a call fails with plan_limit and the person wants more.

interval.description: How often the plan is paid. Default: month

name: upgrade_plan
title: Get a payment link for the paid plan
